capabilities: Display ICOR Journey and Growth Assignment dashboards inside the vault
Search the Inner Circle knowledge base without leaving Obsidian
Sync reflections into the vault as ordinary notes the user owns
Browse ICOR courses and lessons in the vault
Choose whether connection keys stay on the device or follow the vault
extras: README marks the plugin as beta with rough edges expected; it connects only to app.myicor.com and requires connecting on desktop first for mobile to work. Listed as part of the ICOR for Life suite and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it because the method and the notes belong together: having the course in one window and the vault in another forces carrying learning over by hand.
problem: Course content, dashboards, and the knowledge base live behind a browser tab, separate from the notes a member writes about what they learn.
summary: myICOR account integration that shows ICOR Journey and Growth Assignment dashboards, searches the Inner Circle knowledge base, and syncs reflections as vault notes.
